confirmBootstrapIdentity: Confirm the console already contains {saveName} for {profile} ({edition}), revision {revision}, bootstrap SHA-256 {digest}. The app cannot read saved program contents. If unsure, prepare and save the matching bootstrap instead.
confirmBootstrapIdentityAction: I confirm this exact saved bootstrap
allowBootstrapOverwrite: I authorize replacing this saved program if it already exists
bootstrapPersistenceError: The saved-bootstrap identity could not be stored. Check local file permissions; do not assume it will be available after relaunch.
diagnosticsPrivacy: Logs are redacted for viewing. Session folders contain private data; share only an exported support bundle. Bundles include structured state, verification and fixed log summaries, never raw logs, pairing details, account identifiers or save data.
noLogOutput: No output from this source in this run.
localDataFolders: Local data: {support}/runs (private temporary sessions), past-runs (ended sessions), diagnostics (redacted logs), support-bundles (shareable ZIPs), runtime (installed assets). Retain backups and verified exports in their chosen folders.
cleanupScope: Delete only the listed temporary logs and pairing/result metadata from inactive sessions. Backups, save exports, dumps, unknown files, installed runtime assets and support bundles are kept. This cannot be undone.
nothingToClean: No safe temporary files to delete.
diagnosticsFailed: Diagnostics action could not be completed. Cleanup requires no session lease; a live or unknown owner cannot be cleared. Review recovery before trying again.
usbInputAvailable: Supervised keyboard input is available; each operation waits for enumeration.
usbEnumerationObserved: Keyboard enumeration was observed on {controller}. Each operation re-enumerates; console text acceptance is not verified.
usbKeyboardUnavailable: Live keyboard forwarding is unavailable: select built-in USB keyboard input with a supervised keyboard adapter.
usbKeyboardSafety: Use the console's US English keyboard layout. Escape stops forwarding. Leaving the input area or window releases every key. Partial input requires inspection and a console restart.
usbKeyboardCapture: Keyboard forwarding area. Type here; Escape or Tab stops forwarding.
usbKeyboardOpening: Waiting for the console to enumerate the keyboard…
usbKeyboardClosing: Closing keyboard input. Waiting for neutral key release…
usbHelpersUnavailable: USB helpers are unavailable. Use guided manual input.
usbDeveloperHelpers: Developer-staged USB helpers, not redistributable. Console input is not hardware-verified.
usbDiscoverControllers: Run Check readiness to discover attached controllers. A USB-C port alone is not a gadget controller.
usbInvalidSettings: Choose an observed controller and enter whole-number delays within the displayed bounds.
usbConfirmEditor: Confirm SmileBASIC has an empty slot 0 editor focused before typing the bootstrap.
usbConfirmLoad: Confirm SmileBASIC Direct mode is focused before sending LOAD.
usbConfirmLoadPrompt: Confirm the console shows the LOAD YES or LOADV OK prompt.
usbConfirmRun: Confirm the matching bootstrap loaded into slot 0 and Direct mode is focused before RUN.
usbConfirmRemove: Confirm RUN finished and Direct mode is focused before REMOVE. Never repeat REMOVE in the same game session.
usbConfirmStart: Inspect the expected REMOVE result and confirm Direct mode is focused before sending this session's START.
usbConfirmSave: Confirm the complete, checked bootstrap is in slot 0 and Direct mode is focused before SAVE. Confirm any overwrite on the console yourself.
izmyshUnavailable: IZMYSH cannot launch yet. Its separate native qualification adapter is not implemented.
matchingBootstrapRequired: Prepare and save the matching bootstrap for {profile} ({edition}) as {saveName}, then confirm the console save before launching.
automaticLAN: Automatic recommendation; leave empty to rediscover
usbOnly: Required for built-in USB input, not guided manual input.
consoleFirmware: Switch 2 firmware 23.0.1 is the reference target. Newer firmware is not assumed compatible.
smilebasicPrerequisites: Use SmileBASIC full 4.4.9, or demo 4.4.6 only with a demo-capable host. Keep the game on internal storage with more than 20 MiB free in its save.
networkPrerequisites: Connect the console by Ethernet to a LAN reachable from this host. Use a US English USB keyboard layout.
cablePrerequisites: Use a USB-C data cable, not a charge-only cable. The Mac must receive power from the console for the required USB data direction.
driverSecurityGuidance: USB input requires Apple Silicon macOS 14 or later and an approved unsigned driver. Review Recovery and startup security requirements yourself. This readiness check never installs a driver or changes SIP or startup security.
applyBeforeLaunch: Apply the host and input preferences before preparing or launching a session.
chooseKnownHost: Choose a host from Developer Options. The saved host is not in the pinned manifest.
unsupportedEdition: This host does not support that edition. Select full SmileBASIC 4.4.9 or choose a demo-capable host.
chooseTransport: Select manual, keyboard, composite or external-pico input.
chooseLANIPv4: Enter a usable LAN IPv4 address, or clear the override to use network discovery.
toolsReadOnly: These tools are read-only. This build has no console write path: no save, mod, launcher or filesystem write is possible here.
toolsNeedLease: Advanced Tools need a verified session with a live retained RPC lease, or a connection to an existing one.
toolsOwned: This app owns the verified retained session.
toolsAttached: Connected to a verified session another app owns. Only that app can finish it.
toolsLost: The retained session was lost. It is never reconnected automatically; restart the console before another attempt.
toolsCleanupBlocked: A tool could not prove native cleanup. Restart the console before closing this session.
toolsNotPermitted: This host profile does not enable this tool.
toolsOwner: {tool} owns the retained session. Stop it before starting another tool.
toolsFind: Find verified sessions on this Mac
toolsAttachNote: Connecting attaches to a session that is already verified. It does not retype commands or rebuild the exploit.
toolsDetachNote: Disconnecting releases this app's own resources. The original host keeps running on the console.
toolsNoSessions: No verified retained session was found on this Mac.
toolsDumpSaved: Verified capture kept outside the session folder at {path}
toolsOunceFtp: Start read-only FTP export on this Mac
toolsFailed: The last Advanced Tools action could not be completed. Check diagnostics; nothing was retried.
hostUnsupported: Not supported by this host. Choose a compatible host in Developer Options.
requiresVerifiedSession: Requires a verified retained-RPC session and the tool adapter.
supportedEdition: Supported edition. Use the matching bootstrap setup.
transportUnverified: Input preference only. Readiness must verify the actual transport before use.

@noSession.description: Idle shell status, not a readiness claim.

simulatedEnvironment: Simulated environment. No real hardware checks.
restartConsole: Inspect and clear any partial console input. Restart the console before another attempt. Do not blindly retry.
safeFailure: The operation failed before console input. Check diagnostics, then run readiness checks.
commandRejected: This action is not available in the current session state.
savePrompt: Complete the console save or overwrite prompt, then confirm here.
buildLimitations: Development shell. Console workflows are not available yet.

@buildLimitations.description: Honest scope of the initial scaffold.

driverDisclosure: This driver is unsigned. It requires reduced startup security and user-approved kernel extensions. Re-enabling full protection with this driver has not been verified.
driverSigning: The pinned upstream setup also calls for disabling SIP, which reduces macOS protection. A working custom configuration may differ. Signing or notarizing this app does not approve the kernel extension. The app never changes SIP or startup security.
driverRecovery: If you choose USB input, shut down your Apple Silicon Mac, hold the power button for startup options, choose Options, then open Startup Security Utility in Recovery. Review Reduced Security and the option to allow user management of kernel extensions from identified developers. These steps are yours to perform, not commands run by this app. Do not change a working custom security configuration blindly.
driverApproval: After installation, review the kernel-extension approval request in System Settings, Privacy & Security. Follow macOS approval and restart prompts. An unsigned extension may still be rejected by the current policy; a SIP status summary cannot prove compatibility.
driverRestart: Every installation or reinstall requires a Mac restart. After approval and restart, check readiness again. A loaded driver does not prove USB keyboard enumeration or accepted console input.
driverConfirmText: I understand the security consequences. Continue to the macOS administrator prompt to run the verified upstream installer. This does not change startup security for me.
driverInstalling: Waiting for administrator approval and driver installation. Do not start a console session.
driverInstallError: Installation did not complete. It may have changed the installed driver. Check approval and restart state before retrying.
driverDeveloper: Developer-supplied pinned driver source. Not bundled or cleared for redistribution.
driverNoSecurityChange: Guided manual launch does not require this driver or reduced security.
driverVerifyError: Driver package verification or availability failed. Nothing was installed. Restore the pinned driver files before retrying.
automatedInputUnavailable: Automated console input is not available.
selectGuidedManual: Select manual input to use Guided manual launch without a USB driver.
manualInputAvailable: Guided manual input is available. You enter and acknowledge each console step.
manualSlot: Open an empty Slot 0 editor on the console. Confirm the slot is empty before continuing.
manualBootstrap: Enter this complete matching bootstrap.bas in Slot 0. Continue only after checking every line.
manualDirect: Return to Direct mode with an empty prompt, keeping the complete bootstrap in Slot 0.
manualSave: Enter this command and press Enter once. Handle any save or overwrite prompt on the console deliberately. Confirm the completed save in the next step.
manualLoad: Enter this command in Direct mode and press Enter once.
manualLoadConfirm: Accept the console's YES (full) or OK (demo) load prompt with Enter. Wait at least one second after it finishes before continuing.
manualRun: Enter RUN and press Enter. Continue when the console returns to its prompt.
manualRemove: Enter REMOVE once and press Enter. The expected result is Out of memory. Never repeat REMOVE in the same game session. Stop if the result differs.
manualStart: After the expected Out of memory, enter this session-bound START command and press Enter. Acknowledging input is not verification.
resourcesReleased: Cleanup confirmed: input released, tools stopped and owned host processes closed.
verificationEvidence: 4/4 verified: exploit and filesystem verified, filesystem restored, cleanup confirmed.
heldVerificationEvidence: Verified retained session: filesystem verified and restored, donor cleaned up, deferred cleanup and live RPC confirmed.
civPrerequisites: This is a separate Civilization VII route, not SmileBASIC. Confirm the physical Switch 1 edition cartridge, version 1.0.0, and English (US) system language. Keep the console on the same reachable LAN and the in-game lobby chat input focused.
civNoRPC: CivSwitch does not provide the SmileBASIC held RPC session. ns2jb homebrew and SaveKit are unavailable from this path.
civCartridge: Physical Switch 1 Civilization VII cartridge, version 1.0.0
civNetwork: Console and host are on the same reachable network
civChat: In-game lobby chat input is focused
civComposite: Composite keyboard + gamepad HID is required for a new transfer. Keyboard-only HID is not equivalent. Select composite input in Developer Options.
civDuration: The 87-line transfer typically takes 20–25 minutes. Progress comes from completed helper lines, not a timer.
civEstimate: Helper duration estimate: {seconds} seconds. This is an estimate, not measured completion.
civStop: Stop CivSwitch and release both HID interfaces
civVerified: CivSwitch Remote JS Loader verified on TCP 9026. This is not ns2jb verification.
civProbe: The loader must answer its protocol challenge on TCP 9026 before dependent actions are allowed. An open port alone is not verification.
consoleRestartConfirmed: I restarted the console, prepare a new attempt
civDisconnectNote: Disconnect releases local resources. It does not stop the loader running on the console.
civPersistence: Persistence, Control Center and code actions
civDependentNote: Each action below rechecks the loader on TCP 9026 first. A loader verified earlier is not proof that it still answers.
civTriggerWarning: Installing the boot trigger replaces the game's single-player save files in save:/saves/Single. The current saves are read back and verified first, and that backup is kept outside the session folder.
civTriggerConsent: I understand that this replaces the Civilization VII single-player save files
civTriggerInstalled: The boot trigger is installed. Reboot the game and choose Load Game to reopen the loader.
civCodeWarning: Sending or staging a JavaScript file executes arbitrary code in the loader context. Payload Mode does not restrict it. Use only files you reviewed and trust.
civCodeConsent: I reviewed this file and accept arbitrary code execution on the console
civControlStageNote: Open Payload Mode on the console first. After the transfer, press A on the console to start the payload or B to return without starting it.
civControlStage: Stage payload in Control Center Payload Mode
civControlNote: Control Center is read-only: save and content inventories, the controller input monitor, and a verified save export. While it runs, this app sends no further code to the console.
civControlLive: Control Center is connected. Drive its tools with the controller, and keep the game and network connected.
civOpenFailed: The folder could not be opened. Its path is shown above.
